observations.title: See additional cosmetic particles
observations.player_action: Observe crystal-like blocks, hit mobs or watch slimes and environmental effects.
observations.outcome: The Forge port supplies sparkles, hit particles, slime blobs and other cosmetic particles.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Configure the Forge port's effects
observations.player_action: Edit visuality-client.toml or use the optional Configured screen.
observations.outcome: The particle presentation can be adjusted client-side.
conditions: A displayed hit particle is not authoritative proof of damage, kill or boss progress.
